game_concept: A card battler set in Mt. Pyre – Magma Forge, a forge fed by magma: the ash ranger must handle fire sprites while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Boolean Circuit: Toggle True/False switches so a combined and/or/not expression powers the summit beacon.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Magma Forge: a forge fed by magma
core_gameplay_loop: In Magma Forge, repeat each round: Toggle True/False switches so a combined and/or/not expression powers the summit beacon. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the power_on value and advance.
player_objective: Chain 7 consecutive correct decisions about power_on to power up the ash ranger and open the summit beacon.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 5 (applied tier): Boolean Circuit
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Boolean Circuit' (Week 2 slot 6), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Magma Forge'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mt. Pyre
region.mood: low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how power_on changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against fire sprites in Magma Forge.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: streak counter reaches 7.
